victory.songTitle: I Never Shall Forget the Day
victory.line: To faith in him or sin I have a victory
stanza: Now I can feel, him at my side
My fewer steps, he comes to guide
When trials come, he comforts me
To faith in him or sin I have a victory

victory.songTitle: I Knew You Were Waiting (For Me)
victory.line: I know the taste of victory
stanza: Like a warrior that fights and wins the battle
I know the taste of victory
Though I went through some nights consumed by the shadows

valedictory.line: So couldn't we skip the valedictories?
stanza: The ants weigh more than the elephants
So couldn't we skip the valedictories?
I can see a door there
Shut it and forget my number
